resources.string: Open a ready-made .wastickers file and send it cleanly to WhatsApp
Get a .wastickers file from @tgtowabot or sticker-convert, then use the button below.
Packs already added to WhatsApp will NOT disappear there; remove them inside WhatsApp. Re-import from your source file if needed.
Deleted the in-app sticker pack copy
Follow the system wallpaper on Android 12+, including dark mode
Used to build an MD3 palette when dynamic color is off or unavailable
An unknown error occurred. Please try another file.
WhatsApp was not detected. Install WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business, then try again.
Saved %1$d sticker pack(s) inside this app
%1$d stickers were automatically split into %2$d packs within WhatsApp limits
Sticker %1$d has a different animation type from this pack; skipped
Animated WebP #%1$d is %2$d KB, over 500 KB. Animated WebP cannot be re-encoded; export a smaller pack.
Static sticker #%1$d is still over 100 KB after compression (%2$d KB); skipped
Sticker #%1$d could not be decoded; skipped
Added. Find it in the WhatsApp sticker list.
WhatsApp did not confirm the addition. Ensure it is up to date and the pack meets the sticker specs.
WhatsApp returned an unexpected result. Retry or update WhatsApp.
An animated sticker exceeds 500 KB. Animated WebP cannot be re-encoded; export a smaller pack.
A static sticker exceeds 100 KB. Re-export with sticker-convert at lower quality.
Stickers must be exactly 512×512 WebP. Re-export the pack.
WhatsApp requires 3–30 stickers per pack. Check the image count.
A sticker is missing emoji metadata. This app supplies a default; try importing again.
Tray icon must be a 96×96 PNG under 50 KB. Regenerate the pack.
A sticker is not WebP. Re-export with sticker-convert.
